title: Trump says U.S. carried out ‘minor strikes’ on Iran as missiles hit Qeshm Island
summary_full: Trump said the U.S. carried out ‘minor strikes’ on Iran after Iranian media reported two missiles hit Qeshm Island near the Strait of Hormuz.
summary_public: Trump said the U.S. carried out ‘minor strikes’ on Iran after Iranian media reported two missiles hit Qeshm Island near the Strait of Hormuz.
